question: Does an independently published projectable HMT/U(1) matter-coupling principle source-lock the physical matter/source and A/Newtonian-prepotential interfaces strongly enough to make the P(X)-selected Z7 carrier response unique, without using the already observed RTK finite-k or soft-s results?

independent_sources.role: universal gravity-matter coupling in Hořava-Lifshitz gravity with extra U(1), explicitly including projectable case
explicit projectable covariant-HL matter action written with physical ADM variables and A/Newtonian-prepotential context

decision_rule: UNIQUE_PASS requires one source-locked projectable HMT/U(1) matter action whose physical ADM map and A/prepotential dependence uniquely determine the response/source interface with no unfixed coupling parameters relevant to the linear scalar response. PARTIAL_PASS applies if an independent projectable universal-coupling class exists and explicitly uses the HMT auxiliary structure, but leaves a continuous coupling family so the RTK numerator/interface is not unique. BLOCKED applies if no such projectable source-locked class is found.
required_guards: sources predate current RTK soft-s obstruction
no coefficients selected from RTK pole/residue/remainder
no coefficients selected from failed soft-s observable
do not promote a coupling class to a unique RTK action
